name: Controlled Hadamard
summary: The controlled Hadamard is a CNOT conjugated by S·H·T on the target.
description: The controlled Hadamard gate can be written as $(I\otimes S^\dagger H T^\dagger)\,\mathrm{CNOT}\,(I\otimes T H S)$ (gates in the order they are applied: S, H, T, CNOT, T†, H, S† on the target), using two T gates.
